title: My Stepson Forged My Name, Sold Our $1.4M Diner, And Mailed Me A $4,500 Check. So I Voided It.
description: I drained my 401(k) to build a diner with my stepson, only for him to forge my signature, sell it for $1.4 million, and mail me a $4,500 'gratitude' check. I found our original contract, proved the forgery, and voided the sale. Now he scrubs my grill wearing a shirt that reads 'Flipped on Family,' and every receipt prints his felony case number. #GriddleOfGuilt #PettyRevenge #FamilyBetrayal
thumb_text: HE FORGED MY NAME. NOW HE SCRUBS MY GRILL.
pinned_comment: What would you do if your stepson forged your signature, sold your shared diner for $1.4 million, and mailed you a $4,500 'gratitude' check? If you’ve ever been betrayed by family like this, I’d love to hear your story in the comments.
